mechanics.name: Golisopod fainting and replacement
mechanics.behavior: When Golisopod's HP reaches 0, faintMessages runs the BeforeFaint and Faint events and the ability and item End events, clears volatiles and sets fainted. Base formeRegression is not set for champions megas, so Mega Golisopod stays Mega-detailed after fainting. Emergency Exit never activates on a KO, because every trigger path requires hp > 0. At the end of the turn (queue empty), checkFainted sets switchFlag on fainted actives. A forced switch request follows when bench Pokemon remain. The replacement comes in through 'instaswitch' / switchIn.
mechanics.champions_override: Mega is not reverted on faint (champions formeChange).

mechanics.name: Team preview, bring 4 of 6 (Flat Rules)
mechanics.behavior: Format '[Gen 9 Champions] VGC 2026 Reg M-C': mod champions, doubles, ruleset Flat Rules + VGC Timer + Open Team Sheets. Flat Rules includes Team Preview and Picked Team Size = Auto, which is 4 in doubles. The 'team' action rebuilds side.pokemon from the chosen order, so bench slots are indexes 2..3. canSwitch counts unfainted Pokemon in those bench slots, and that count gates Emergency Exit. Golisopod may not be brought at all. Open Team Sheets reveals Golisopite, Emergency Exit and the moves (information profile only).
mechanics.uncertainty: I did not trace the team-preview choice parsing (sim/side.ts chooseTeam) for this entry.

mechanics.name: Accuracy roll
mechanics.behavior: In hitStepAccuracy (hit step 4): accuracy = ModifyAccuracy(move.accuracy), then stage-adjusted: boost = user accuracy - target evasion, clamped to ±6. Positive boost: tr(acc*(3+b)/3). Negative boost: tr(acc*3/(3-b)). Then the Accuracy event runs (No Guard returns true). If accuracy is not true, randomChance(acc,100) = random(100) < acc. This draw is consumed even for 100-accuracy moves. It is skipped for accuracy === true (self-target Status such as Protect, Struggle, or No Guard involvement), and for targets already filtered out by earlier steps (Protect in TryHit step 1, type immunity step 2). A miss logs '-miss'. There is no Blunder Policy here.
mechanics.rng_draws: One random(100) per target per move that reaches step 4 with non-true accuracy.
mechanics.uncertainty: I did not examine the PRNG algorithm behind rng.next() (sim/prng.ts). Only the draw call shapes are mapped.

mechanics.name: Critical hit roll
mechanics.behavior: In getDamage, before the BasePower event: critRatio = ModifyCritRatio(move.critRatio). Dex default is 1, Drill Run is 2. It is clamped to 0..4 with gen 7+ table [0,24,8,2,1], and crit = randomChance(1, table[ratio]): 1/24 normally, 1/8 for Drill Run. The CriticalHit event has no handlers here. Effects: damage tr(x*1.5); negative attacker boosts (Intimidate) and positive defender boosts (Grassy Seed Def +1) are ignored; screens do not apply.
mechanics.rng_draws: random(24) or random(8) per target hit.

mechanics.name: Damage random factor
mechanics.behavior: randomizer(d) = tr(tr(d*(100 - random(16)))/100), giving 85-100%. It is applied after the crit multiply and before STAB in champions modifyDamage. It happens once per target per hit.
mechanics.rng_draws: random(16) per target per hit.

mechanics.name: Secondary effect roll
mechanics.behavior: secondaries(): for each target still hit, after ModifySecondaries (no handlers here), each secondary draws random(100). The effect applies if roll < chance (Iron Head flinch: 20). It runs after damage and after self-drops (step 5 of spreadMoveHit). Leech Life and Drill Run have no secondary and cause no draw.
mechanics.rng_draws: random(100) per secondary per hit target.

mechanics.name: Speed-tie shuffle
mechanics.behavior: speedSort is a selection sort over comparePriority. Groups of equal elements are shuffled with prng.shuffle, a Fisher-Yates using random(start,end). It is used for the action queue (including megaEvo actions and post-action re-sorts) and for eachEvent and field events such as residual ordering and Update. Golisopod's 61 Spe ties none of the 12 base-set speeds, but ties can arise under modifiers, and draws are still consumed for other tied groups.
mechanics.rng_draws: random(start,end) per swap position inside each tied group.

mechanics.name: Random target selection
mechanics.behavior: getRandomTarget in doubles (activePerHalf 2) calls side.randomFoe(), which is battle.sample(foe.allies()) over live foes. It is used for Struggle (randomNormal) and for retargeting a 'normal' move whose chosen foe slot is fainted or invalid. It runs from resolveAction (no targetLoc), runMove -> getTarget, and getActionSpeed -> getTarget.
mechanics.rng_draws: random(n) per call, including when n = 1.

mechanics.name: Grassy Terrain (Team A Rillaboom's Grassy Surge) as it affects Golisopod
mechanics.behavior: The terrain lasts 5 turns (no Terrain Extender). Residual (order 5, subOrder 2): heal(baseMaxhp/16) to Golisopod, who is grounded in both formes. That is 182/16 = 11.375, truncated to 11 HP. The heal can lift HP above 91 and re-arm Emergency Exit, but it can never trigger it. BasePower: Grass moves from grounded attackers get x5325/4096, which boosts Team A's Wood Hammer and Grassy Glide against Golisopod. Earthquake, Bulldoze and Magnitude would be halved, so Drill Run is not affected. Golisopod's own moves receive no boost. Grassy Glide gets +1 priority in the terrain (its own handler), which ally Armor Tail blocks.

mechanics.name: Trick Room (ally Farigiraf) as it affects Golisopod
mechanics.behavior: pseudoWeather 'trickroom', 5 turns. Under champions getActionSpeed, speed = -spe, so Golisopod (61, the slowest of the 12 sets) acts first among equal-priority moves. megaEvo action order among Pokemon also inverts. This makes Iron Head's 20% flinch relevant against faster foes.
mechanics.champions_override: Negation instead of 10000 - speed with 13-bit truncation.
mechanics.uncertainty: I did not read the full Trick Room condition body (duration and toggle handlers) for this entry.

mechanics.name: Rain (ally Politoed Drizzle) / Sun (Mega Charizard Y Drought) as they affect Golisopod
mechanics.behavior: The WeatherModifyDamage event runs before the crit multiply. Rain: Water x1.5, Fire x0.5. Sun: Fire x1.5, Water x0.5, and sun grants freeze immunity. Golisopod's own moves (Bug, Steel, Ground) are unaffected. Defensively, rain halves Team A's Bitter Blade against Mega Golisopod (4x weak) and boosts Milotic's Muddy Water against Golisopod. Sun needs Charizard to Mega Evolve, which rules out Golisopod's Mega in the same battle (one Mega per side). Base Golisopod under sun is neutral to Fire.
mechanics.uncertainty: I did not read the weather duration and Drizzle/Drought handler lines for this entry.

mechanics.name: Reflect / Light Screen (ally Grimmsnarl, Light Clay 8 turns) as they affect Golisopod
mechanics.behavior: Reflect onAnyModifyDamage: if target != source, the target is on the screen side and the move is Physical and not a crit, multiply by 2732/4096 in doubles (activePerHalf > 1). Light Screen does the same for Special moves. Light Clay makes the duration 8. Effect on Golisopod: it takes less damage from Team A. The condition does not check the attacker's side, so Golisopod's own attacks on its own ally are also reduced by its side's Reflect.
mechanics.uncertainty: I read the Light Screen lines only by location and assume they mirror Reflect.

mechanics.name: Intimidate (Team A Staraptor), received by Golisopod
mechanics.behavior: onStart for each adjacent foe: boost atk -1 unless Substitute (none). Golisopod has no blocking ability (not Emergency Exit, not Tough Claws) and no blocking item. The -1 is a stat stage, so it survives Mega Evolution. Atk becomes floor(194/1.5) = 129 before Mega or floor(222/1.5) = 148 after. A crit ignores it. Mega Staraptor's ability is Contrary. Because champions Megas persist, a Mega Staraptor that switches back in does not Intimidate. Milotic's Competitive is never triggered by Golisopod, which has no stat-lowering effect.

mechanics.name: No Guard (Team A Mega Raichu Y), interaction with Golisopod
mechanics.behavior: onAnyAccuracy returns true when either the user or the target is the No Guard holder. Golisopod's Drill Run, Leech Life and Iron Head against Mega Raichu Y therefore skip the accuracy draw. Raichu's Zap Cannon (acc 50, 100% paralysis) against Golisopod always hits once Raichu is Mega. Only after Raichu has Mega Evolved; base Raichu has Lightning Rod, which never matters because Golisopod has no Electric moves. Protect still blocks.

mechanics.name: Armor Tail (ally Farigiraf) protecting Golisopod
mechanics.behavior: onFoeTryMove: if a foe's move has priority > 0.1 and its target is on the holder's side, the move is blocked. The exceptions are foeSide moves and 'all' moves other than Perish Song, Flower Shield and Rototiller. This blocks Team A's Fake Out (+3), Grassy Glide (+1 in Grassy Terrain) and Shadow Sneak (+1) aimed at Golisopod. It does not affect Golisopod's own moves (none has priority > 0 except self-target Protect, and Golisopod is not a foe of the holder). The flag is breakable (no Mold Breaker in the matchup).

mechanics.name: Stamina (ally Archaludon), if Golisopod targets its ally
mechanics.behavior: onDamagingHit: boost def +1 on Archaludon for each damaging hit. This is reachable only through a player-selected ally-targeted Leech Life (0.5x), Iron Head (0.5x) or Drill Run (2x). It belongs to the complete command domain, not typical play.

mechanics.name: Paralysis on Golisopod
mechanics.behavior: Source: Team A's Zap Cannon (100% paralysis, acc 50; always hits when Raichu is Mega through No Guard). Golisopod is not Electric in either forme, so it is not immune. Champions onBeforeMove: randomChance(1,8) full paralysis ('cant'). Base onModifySpe, applied after all other modifiers: floor(spe*50/100), so 61 becomes 30. No PP is spent when fully paralysed.
mechanics.champions_override: Full paralysis chance changed from 1/4 to 1/8.
mechanics.rng_draws: random(8) per move attempt.

mechanics.name: Sleep on Golisopod
mechanics.behavior: Source: Team A Milotic's Hypnosis (acc 60, blocked by Protect). Neither forme is immune. Champions onStart sets startTime = sample([2,3,3]). Base onBeforeMove decrements time and wakes (then acts) when time <= 0. So Golisopod loses 1 move attempt with probability 1/3, or 2 attempts with probability 2/3. This format has no Sleep Clause (Flat Rules).
mechanics.champions_override: Sleep duration sample([2,3,3]) instead of random(2,5).
mechanics.rng_draws: sample over 3 items (random(3)) when sleep is inflicted.

mechanics.name: Freeze on Golisopod
mechanics.behavior: Source: Team A Milotic's Ice Beam (10% freeze). Golisopod is not Ice, so it can be frozen, except that sun grants immunity. Champions onStart sets time = 3. onBeforeMove: time--, then thaw and act if time <= 0 or randomChance(1,4). That thaw is guaranteed on the 3rd attempt, and there is no draw when time reaches 0 first. The base onDamagingHit thaws Golisopod when it is hit by a damaging Fire move (Team A's Bitter Blade). Golisopod has no defrost moves.
mechanics.champions_override: Maximum 3 attempts with a 25% thaw each, instead of 20% per attempt with no cap.
mechanics.rng_draws: random(4) per move attempt while time > 0 after the decrement.

mechanics.name: Confusion on Golisopod (ally-inflicted only)
mechanics.behavior: This can happen only if ally Charizard targets Golisopod with Hurricane (target 'any', 30% confusion). No Team A move confuses. Duration random(2,6). Each move attempt: time--; at 0 the confusion ends. Otherwise randomChance(33,100) causes a 40 BP typeless self-hit through getConfusionDamage and battle.damage, and the move is skipped. PS has no EmergencyExit check after this self-damage.
mechanics.rng_draws: random(2,6) when confusion starts. random(100) per attempt while confused, plus damage and crit draws inside getConfusionDamage (not examined).
mechanics.uncertainty: I did not read getConfusionDamage internals (sim/battle-actions.ts:1850+). Whether cartridge Champions lets Emergency Exit trigger from a confusion self-hit is unknown.

mechanics.name: Golisopod-adjacent mechanics NOT reachable with these two teams (scope guard)
mechanics.behavior: These are not reachable for Golisopod with these two teams and can be rejected by an explicit guard rather than implemented. Burn and its physical-damage halving: the only burn source, Charizard's Heat Wave, targets allAdjacentFoes only. Poison: no source, and the Mega is immune anyway. Residual damage to Golisopod: none, so the residual Emergency Exit path is dead. Entry hazards: none, so the runSwitch Emergency Exit path is dead. Contact recoil or damage (Rough Skin, Iron Barbs, Rocky Helmet, Static, Flame Body): none, so the attacker DamagingHit Emergency Exit path is dead. Crash damage and Life Orb on Golisopod: none. Item removal, so Golisopite's onTakeItem is never exercised. Heal Block and Liquid Ooze on drain. Pressure on PP. Protect bypass (Feint, Unseen Fist). Copy or call effects (Metronome, Copycat, Instruct, Dancer, Mirror Move): none on either team, so Golisopod's mirror and metronome flags are inert. Sheer Force on an attacker, which would suppress the Emergency Exit check.
mechanics.uncertainty: These are unreachability claims from my reading of all 24 listed moves and 12 abilities and items in the task's team text. I did not open every other member's move entry in full (for example Close Combat, Brave Bird, Make It Rain), so other members' closure maps should confirm them.

Not triggered by status moves, Intimidate, Grassy Terrain or Struggle recoil on the attacker. Reachable from every damaging Team A move that is not immune/blocked, including Fake Out (once, +1 Def then flinch) and from an ally-targeted hit. The boost is a normal stat stage: capped at +6, reset on switch-out, shown publicly (-boost event). Crits ignore it.

mechanics.name: Leftovers
mechanics.behavior: onResidual (order 5, subOrder 4): heal(baseMaxhp/16) = 12 HP per end of turn while below max HP; no effect at full HP. Not consumable; no removal effect exists in Team A (no Knock Off, Trick or Thief). Runs after Grassy Terrain heal (order 5 sub 2) of the same Pokemon within the speed-ordered residual pass.

mechanics.name: Dragon Pulse
mechanics.behavior: Special Dragon 85 BP, accuracy 100, pp 10 (champions 12), flags protect/mirror/distance/pulse, target any. No secondary. STAB 1.5. Against Team A: neutral on everything except Gholdengo (Steel, 0.5). No Fairy in Team A. Mega Launcher absent. In the M2 domain "any" offers ally and both foes.
mechanics.rng_draws: accuracy 1, crit 1, damage 1 per hit

mechanics.name: Electro Shot (charge move, rain skips the charge)
mechanics.behavior: Special Electric 130 BP, accuracy 100, pp 10 (champions 12), flags charge/protect/mirror, target normal. onTryMove: on the first turn it announces -prepare, boosts the user SpA +1 (always, even if the attack then charges), and if the user's effectiveWeather is raindance it attacks in the same turn; otherwise it adds the twoturnmove volatile and returns null (no hit, no accuracy or damage draw). On the next turn removeVolatile(electroshot) succeeds, so the SpA boost is NOT applied again and the attack executes with the stored targetLoc. The user is not semi-invulnerable while charging. PP is deducted once, on the charge turn. If the stored target has fainted the normal retargeting applies (getTarget fallback to a random foe). Against Team A: 2x on Staraptor and Milotic, 0.5x on Rillaboom, neutral on Ceruledge (Fire/Ghost) and Gholdengo, Raichu absorbs it through Lightning Rod (immune, +1 SpA to Raichu) and redirects any Electric move to itself while it is base forme; after Mega Evolution (No Guard) there is no redirection.
mechanics.rng_draws: charge turn: 0; attack turn: accuracy 1, crit 1, damage 1

mechanics.name: twoturnmove / electroshot volatiles
mechanics.behavior: twoturnmove (duration 2) stores the move id and the original targetLoc, adds the move-named volatile, runs PrepareHit, and its onLockMove forces the same move next turn: the next request for that slot offers only Electro Shot and sets trapped = true (getMoveRequestData: a locked move traps), so the slot can neither pick another move nor switch, and Mega is not offered. onMoveAborted removes it (e.g. full paralysis, sleep, flinch on the release turn cancel the attack and the charge is lost). Switching out clears it. If Archaludon is hit by Fake Out while charging, the flinch aborts the release.
mechanics.uncertainty: M2 domain gap: a locked move must restrict the offered domain to that move and forbid switching; DuoForge has no locked-move state yet (state v3, M3/M4).

mechanics.name: Snarl (spread, guaranteed -1 SpA)
mechanics.behavior: Special Dark 55 BP, accuracy 95, pp 15 (champions 16), flags protect/mirror/sound/bypasssub, target allAdjacentFoes. Spread modifier 0.75 when more than one target was selected at hit time (spreadHit). Secondary chance 100: -1 SpA per hit target; the roll random(100) is still drawn per target. Sound: no Soundproof in Team A. Type: 2x on Ceruledge and Gholdengo (Ghost), neutral elsewhere; STAB 1.5. Competitive (Milotic) answers the drop with +2 SpA; Contrary (Mega Staraptor) turns it into +1 SpA; Good as Gold does not block damaging moves. Accuracy roll per target (skipped against Mega Raichu Y by No Guard). Mega Staraptor (Fighting/Flying) resists Dark (0.5x).
mechanics.rng_draws: per target: accuracy 1, crit 1, damage 1, secondary 1

mechanics.name: Damage pipeline as it applies to Archaludon
mechanics.behavior: getDamage: base = tr(tr(tr(tr(2*50/5+2) * BP * A) / D) / 50) with A/D from getStat with stages (crit ignores negative attacker / positive defender stages), then champions modifyDamage: spread 0.75 (Snarl), weather (rain/sun for Electric? none; Fire/Water only), crit x1.5 (chance 1/24 at the default critRatio 1; no crit boosters in the matchup), randomizer tr(base*(100-random(16))/100), STAB 1.5, type effectiveness (announced as min(|mod|,2)), burn halving (Archaludon cannot be burned by Team A), then ModifyDamage handlers: Reflect/Light Screen (Team B own screens do not reduce its attacks; Team A has no screens). Defensively: Steel/Dragon takes 2x Fighting (Close Combat, Focus Blast) and Ground (High Horsepower), 0.25x Grass (Wood Hammer, Grassy Glide), Electric (Zap Cannon) and Steel (Make It Rain), 0.5x Normal (Fake Out), Flying (Brave Bird), Water (Muddy Water), neutral Ice, Fire, Ghost. Stamina +1 Def after each hit changes D for later hits in the same turn.

mechanics.behavior: Dragon Pulse: target any (ally, foe a, foe b). Electro Shot: normal (same three positions in doubles); on the release turn the slot is locked to Electro Shot. Snarl: allAdjacentFoes, no selector. Protect: self. Switch to any alive bench member. Mega: none. Struggle when all pp are 0. Targeting an ally is legal (Snarl cannot).

Electro Shot charge turn: none. Protect: stall roll from the second consecutive use. Speed ties: none reachable. Random retarget: sample when the chosen foe fainted and both foe positions matter. Leftovers and Stamina have no switch-in effect. Emergency Exit (ally Golisopod) may create a mid-turn switch request while Archaludon's action is still pending; its queued action survives the pause.

Sitrus Berry (ally) is not residual (onUpdate).

Blocks every Team A move with the protect flag; Feint/Shadow Force do not exist here. onPrepareHit fails if the user is the last to act (queue.willAct false). Champions max PP 8.

Reachable only through PP exhaustion here (no Disable, Taunt, Encore, Torment, Imprison, choice items or Assault Vest in either team); Fake Out is Team A only.

An ally can be targeted (lowers the ally, still switches). After a successful hit, if canSwitch(side) > 0 the user's switchFlag is set and a mid-turn switch request goes to Team B only (one-side PIVOT boundary); with no bench member alive the move still lowers the stats and no request is made. The replacement enters via instaswitch (order 3) and does not act this turn; switch-in abilities (Drizzle, Drought of a Mega Charizard) fire at that moment.

mechanics.name: Champions stat formula (Flat Rules, no Level Clause Mod)
mechanics.behavior: HP = base + SP + 75; other stats = base + SP + 20, then nature trunc(trunc(stat*110,16)/100) or *90. IVs and level do not enter. SP at most 32 per stat and 66 in total (validator). See the per-species entry for the computed line.

mechanics.name: Champions PP
mechanics.behavior: init() caps any move pp above 20 at 20; calculatePP = (pp/5 + 1) * 4 with PP Ups ignored. Protect has champions pp 5 (max 8). One PP is deducted per use in runMove even if the move fails.

mechanics.name: Struggle when every slot has pp 0 or is disabled
mechanics.behavior: The request offers Struggle (pp 1, noPPBoosts) when no move is selectable; canMegaEvo is stripped in that request. Struggle: 50 BP typeless physical, 1/4 max HP recoil, contact. Reachable only through PP exhaustion here (no Disable, Taunt, Encore, Torment, Imprison, choice items or Assault Vest in either team); Fake Out is Team A only.

mechanics.name: Statuses Team A can inflict on this member
mechanics.behavior: Zap Cannon: paralysis (Speed 72 -> 36, Prankster priority unaffected); Hypnosis: sleep; Ice Beam: freeze. Champions: full paralysis 1/8 per move attempt (base 1/4) and Speed halved; sleep lasts sample([2,3,3]) turns (one draw over three values); freeze counter 3 with thaw when the counter reaches 0 or randomChance(1,4), and a Fire-type damaging hit thaws. In sun nobody can be frozen (sunnyday onImmunity). Burn and confusion have no Team A source.

mechanics.name: Grassy Terrain (Rillaboom) on this member
mechanics.behavior: Grounded: heals 1/16 max HP (12) at residual order 5 sub 2 while the terrain lasts; Grassy Glide against it gets +1 priority. High Horsepower is NOT weakened (only Earthquake, Bulldoze and Magnitude are).

mechanics.name: Trick Room ordering for this member
mechanics.behavior: Under Trick Room the champions getActionSpeed returns -speed (72 -> -72), so slower Pokemon act first; priority brackets are unchanged; ties still shuffle. Tailwind (Team A) doubles the stat before negation.
